description: Several contracts in parallel -> one portfolio brief. Exposed as a chat tool.
toolDescription: Reviews several FlowerDocs contracts in parallel and returns an executive portfolio brief: at a glance, contracts to act on now, deadlines and renewals, missing information, and a full table. Use it whenever the user asks to review, compare, triage or summarize several contracts whose document ids you know.

toolInputParameters.description: JSON array of FlowerDocs contract document ids
toolInputParameters.name: docIds
